text: {"verdicts":[{"i":0,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":26,"why":"Patient described pain in the lower abdomen, which is consistent with abdominal pain."},{"i":1,"v":"INFERRED","u":32,"why":"Patient stated the pain is in the lower abdomen and is getting worse, which can be inferred to be periumbilical pain, constant, and getting worse."},{"i":2,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":60,"why":"Patient mentioned that the bowel movements are fine now, but did not specify if they are daily or normal."},{"i":3,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":76,"why":"Patient mentioned only a small vaginal discharge, which can be interpreted as no other significant discharge."},{"i":4,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":83,"why":"Patient explicitly stated that she does not feel feverish."},{"i":5,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":85,"why":"Patient explicitly stated that she does not feel faint when standing up."},{"i":6,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":53,"why":"Patient mentioned feeling like vomiting but not actually vomiting, which can be interpreted as nausea."},{"i":7,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":70,"why":"Patient mentioned that the stool is fine now, which can be interpreted as no diarrhea or vomiting."},{"i":8,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":91,"why":"Patient mentioned having an allergy to amoxicillin."},{"i":9,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":94,"why":"Patient explicitly stated that she has not had any operations."},{"i":10,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":110,"why":"Patient explicitly stated that she does not smoke or drink alcohol."},{"i":11,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":103,"why":"Patient stated that she is a teacher and has been able to work as usual."}]}
